$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

id.description: The disruption id; equals the file name.

kind.description: What it is: it must equal the `kind` of the object it rings at.

ringMaxMs.description: How long it rings if nobody answers, in sim ms, at least one `PHONE_RINGING_EVERY_MS` (1000): a shorter ring would never tick. Then it stops for good.

answerBusyMs.description: How long Papa is on the phone once he picks up (« attention détournée »), in sim ms.

answerFatiguePoints.description: Fatigue points Papa gains when he picks up, in points of the 0-100 gauge.

ring.description: Cue played when the phone starts ringing and at each second it goes on ringing.

answer.description: Cue played when Papa picks up.

feedback.description: Cues of `feedback.json` › `cues` the client plays for this disruption.

description: A kind of disruption: how long it lasts and what answering it costs (GDD › Perturbations).
